title: Loader-verification seven-document reference set ships as framework default by mid-June 2026
body: By mid-June 2026 the agentic-AI loader-verification reference set ships as a seven-document academic-plus-deployment-plus-compliance-monitoring bundle that the LangChain plus AutoGen plus CrewAI plus Haystack plus Pydantic AI maintainer cohort defaults across all six verification surfaces, with the Friday-morning RC1 branch cuts on each project's main converting the prior mid-June commitment into a settled release runway. The Friday catalysts trace a clean close on what had still been the two open questions one business day earlier — the regulatory anchor and the operator-side measurement artifact. A Friday arxiv release (2605.08147) closes the business-week research cycle by adding an operator-side compliance-monitoring evaluation companion to the now-doubly-cleared loader-verification reference set, walking the per-operator compliance-monitoring telemetry across the first 24 hours of the federal-civilian directive's compliance-monitoring phase and reporting per-operator attestation-event rates landing inside the consolidation survey's predicted bounds for a third consecutive cross-section sample on an n-of-eleven operator sample. A Friday Simon Willison note characterizes the paper as the canonical operator-side close on the loader-verification line and observes that the timing — released the same business day the CISA federal-civilian directive transitioned into its compliance-monitoring phase at T-zero and the FMRB classified-annex record cleared eight-of-eight inside the same Friday session — completes a seven-document reference set the framework cohort can cite as a single coherent academic-plus-deployment-plus-compliance-monitoring end-to-end reference, converting the mid-June default-shipment commitment from a downhill release into a release-cycle execution detail. A Friday Hugging Face Blog post reports the maintainer cohort opening the formal mid-June default-shipment release-candidate cycle with a Friday-morning RC1 branch cut on each project's main, covering all six verification surfaces — load-time signed-checkpoint, manifest-allowlist with the nested-dependency-resolution canonicalization extension, workflow-state path-canonicalization, intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization, tenant-policy-attestation manifest, and the consolidation-survey end-to-end conformance run — with the cohort treating the RC1 cut as the formal transition from commitment to shipment runway. A Friday DeepMind note confirms the consolidated Python-and-Rust reference-implementation index ships a Friday-morning supplementary tag bundling Thursday's arxiv 2605.08019 applied-deployment evaluation companion alongside Wednesday's 2605.07891 consolidation survey as the canonical two-paper deployment reference, and Anthropic's Friday operations note documents the open-source verification harness executing the six-document end-to-end conformance run alongside the standard cross-tenant audit across all 74 gated tenants with cross-tenant compositional safety checks holding under 55 seconds. The structural force is that once an operator-side compliance-monitoring measurement artifact joins the existing six-document academic-plus-deployment cluster on the same business day a CISA federal-civilian directive transitions into compliance-monitoring mode and a FMRB classified-annex record clears eight-of-eight, the framework maintainer cohort opens formal RC1 branch cuts covering all six verification surfaces, the consolidated reference-implementation index bundles the canonical two-paper deployment reference as a supplementary tag, and the Anthropic open-source verification harness executes the conformance run cleanly across 74 gated tenants, the seven-document reference set's promotion from commitment to settled default-shipment anchor compresses to RC-cycle release-engineering rather than an unresolved verification question. The most likely landing is the seven-document reference set — the four-paper academic cluster plus arxiv 2605.07891 consolidation survey plus arxiv 2605.08019 applied-deployment companion plus arxiv 2605.08147 operator-side compliance-monitoring companion — shipping as the default verification surface bundle inside the mid-June default-shipment window, with the LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, and Pydantic AI cohort each tagging stable from their Friday RC1 branches inside the mid-June release window, the Mistral Workflows plus Codex CLI plus Claude Code 3.0 plus Azure AI Foundry plus Vertex AI Agent Governance Center plus Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry interop matrix shipping general availability the same first week of June with default support, and the cleared CISA compliance-monitoring phase plus the cleared FMRB executive instrument cited together as the doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop. Bear case is that one of the five RC1 branches logs a schema-drift regression during the dry-run week ahead of mid-June and the default-shipment slips one minor release cycle into late June; absent that, mid-June 2026 lands the seven-document reference set as the framework default-shipment anchor.

reasoning.given: Maintainer cohort opens RC1 branch cuts on Friday morning across all six verification surfaces.
reasoning.so_that: The seven-document reference set ships as the default verification bundle the cohort cites end-to-end.
reasoning.landing: By mid-June 2026; LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, Pydantic AI default it.
reasoning.plain_language: The full set of safety-check papers plus a real-world measurement record will be built into the main AI libraries by mid-June.

summary: Friday arxiv 2605.08147 adds an operator-side compliance-monitoring companion to the six-document loader-verification cluster on the same day the CISA federal-civilian directive transitioned into compliance-monitoring mode and the FMRB classified-annex record cleared eight-of-eight. By mid-June 2026 the seven-document reference set ships as the framework default-shipment anchor.
